name: sopheak/sp-jwt-auth
description: First-party JWT access and rotating refresh token authentication for Laravel apps.

setup.name: publish-and-configure
setup.note: Publishes config and migrations, adds the sp-jwt API guard to config/auth.php, generates local PEM signing keys, and ensures SP_JWT_REFRESH_HASH_KEY is set in .env.

setup.name: migrate
setup.note: Creates the sp_jwt_access_tokens, sp_jwt_refresh_tokens, and account security tables.

setup.name: verify
setup.note: Exits 0 with {"status":"ok"} when the client app is correctly configured, or 1 with a JSON list of errors. Use --fix to attempt safe repairs.

optional_modules.name: api-keys
optional_modules.note: API key authentication. Enable the AuthenticateApiKey middleware and sp-jwt-auth.api_keys.enabled config.

optional_modules.name: first-factor-otp
optional_modules.note: First-factor OTP sign-in/sign-up via SMS or email. Enable sp-jwt-auth.first_factor_otp.enabled and implement the FirstFactorUserResolver contract.

optional_modules.name: oauth
optional_modules.note: OAuth2 authorization server (league/oauth2-server). Requires the suggested league/oauth2-server package.

optional_modules.name: socialite
optional_modules.note: External identity / social login (laravel/socialite). Requires the suggested laravel/socialite package.

optional_modules.name: mfa
optional_modules.note: Multi-factor and OTP challenges. Enable sp-jwt-auth.mfa.enabled / sp-jwt-auth.otp.enabled config.
